item.title: Other Useful Maps for Planning in the Indian Himalaya
item.description: A guide to some lesser-known but genuinely useful map resources for the Indian Himalaya — from Harish Kapadia’s expedition sketches to Depi Chaudhry’s trekking maps and the Pahar archive.
